title: Mapping machine states
statement: For a type $Q$, this inductive type has states for parsing with an optional pending Boolean, copying the second input, moving back across the second or first work area, emitting from the first work area, emitting again with a specified Boolean, and writing a separator. It also has a running state carrying a state $q\in Q$ and a Boolean tag.
